name: booking_reserve
description: Atomically reserve a booking slot for the caller. Uses compare-and-set: succeeds only if the slot is still free. On failure returns alternative free slots to offer the caller.

slot_id.description: Identifier of the slot to reserve, from the shop's slot table (e.g. 'fri-1900').

party_size.description: Number of people for the booking.

caller_id.description: Caller phone number in E.164 form, or an anonymous call id.
